title: Mixed Event — Here on Our Dream Stage — Episode5 What Music Means to Us

meta.Episode: Episode5 — What Music Means to Us
meta.Event Outline: The schools of Shibuya are holding the Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival, a place for students to put on performances. Nene takes on the task of putting on a musical with students from other schools.

rows.Line: A few days later
Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, let's begin practicing for the show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Actually, before we do...
I should probably introduce myself again. My name is Nene Kusanagi. I'm the leader of both this show and this cast, and I'm looking forward to working with all of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Same here!
Hehe. This is so exciting♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm a little worried about acting... I've never done it before in my life.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's okay!
We just gotta help each other out and do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, for today's agenda...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: First, we'll go over the story, and then decide roles. After that, time permitting, we'll try to squeeze in a quick table read.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The director and actors from the troupe I'm in will be assisting me with deciding your roles. So, can you guys introduce yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi! I'm Emu Otori!
I really want this show to make everyone smile, and I look forward to working with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My name is Rui Kamishiro. I'm a third-year at Kamiyama High School. It's my pleasure to be here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My name is Tsukasa Tenma, and I too am a third-year at Kamiyama High School! That's Tenma, written as “soaring pegasus”—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We don't have much time, so can we skip that part?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! But you told us to introduce ourselves!
However, I understand we must use our limited time to its best advantage...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In any case, let's all do our best to make this show a spectacular one! I look forward to working with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, let's start going over the story.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
This story's titled “A Dream On A Melody”.
The protagonist is named Lulu, and she lives in the biggest mansion in town.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Lulu is a sheltered girl, who doesn't know much about the world outside her mansion. But one day, she hears someone singing from the window, and decides to sneak out into town.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's where she meets our cast of musicians, who help her see the beauty of music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The beauty of music...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The musicians teach Lulu how to sing, and she begins sneaking into town without the butler's permission to go sing and hear the others perform.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: As time goes on, she becomes friends with the other musicians, and she starts dreaming of becoming a musician who can make everyone smile.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, that's a cool development!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, things are fun for a while...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But one day, the butler catches her sneaking out of the mansion...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And Lulu is forced to return to her old, confined life.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! That's terrible...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Pretty standard development, but I'd like to hear how things unfold from here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The musicians all gather outside of her mansion and begin singing. Through their performances, they tell each other how they feel about her and this situation.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They fill Lulu with so much courage that she decides to tell everyone in the mansion about her dream...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The story ends with her setting out into the world to become a musician.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had a chance to go over the story, let's start deciding roles.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Normally, roles are given out based on a individual's style and acting abilities.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, that's going to be difficult this time around. Most of you have no acting experience, after all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, for this show, I thought that we could try assigning you all roles which match your personalities.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Roles which match us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, since that should make it much easier for all of you to follow your characters' feelings and ways of thinking.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, we'll need you all to introduce yourselves, and tell us about your feelings regarding singing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our feelings regarding singing...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, because this story involves instilling joy, inspiring bravery and encouraging others to move forward through the power of singing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, knowing how you personally feel about singing should make it easier for us to assign roles to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go in order.
I'm sorry, Hoshino, but would you mind introducing yourself first?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... My name is Ichika Hoshino. I'm a second-year at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm currently the vocalist for our band...
My goal is to sing and perform in a way which allows me to reach the hearts of many different people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm also hoping that my singing will bring others together and help them forge strong bonds.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's what I want to do.
Just like my hero.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So straightforward. That answer does suit her well...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My turn next!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm An Shiraishi, and I'm a second-year at Kamiyama High School! My goal is to sing and stand on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The world!
That's an excellent goal!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My partner, teammates and I are gonna accomplish that by pushing each other to keep getting better!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's what it means for me to sing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe! That goal suits you so well, An!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As for me, my goal is to become a super idol who can spread hope to tons of people!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I plan on doing so by pushing myself to become a better dancer and conversationalist!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And singing obviously means a lot to me, since it's my best tool for spreading hope to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've certainly made your honesty and determination clear.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look how much Airi's sparkling!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They all come from different genres, but they're all passionate about what they do.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They should help make this show a success.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, next... Would you mind introducing yourself?

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: Yes, I'm...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, I believe that's everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, Nene, would you mind finishing us off? What does it mean for you to sing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. You're a part of this cast, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, but...
My plan was just to fill whatever role was left over. Do I really need to?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
Since we're here, I kinda want to hear what your feelings are regarding singing, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. Also, don't say you're just gonna play whatever's left. You should also play the role that suits you the best.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hear that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Alright, fine...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My goal is to become a world-class musical actress.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I want to make as many people as I can smile through my singing.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: A world-class musical actress? That's so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: Does that mean you wanna sing on Broadway?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... I know it's a really lofty goal, considering where I currently am as a singer...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I don't think that's lofty at all, Kusanagi.
I mean, you're such an amazing singer!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think your dream is wonderful, and it suits you really well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know it's a big dream, but my goal is to make it come true no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, let's start deciding roles based on what you've all shared.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Starting with the show's most vital role.
I'd like to begin by choosing who is going to play our protagonist...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I nominate Kusanagi to play her!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're the perfect pick, based on what you just told us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you and she do seem to sync up pretty well, in terms of having the courage to chase after such big dreams.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line:
I agree with them!
Plus, it'll be nice having a veteran leading the way, you know?

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: I also vote for you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Right.
Based on what you said, Nene, I also believe you should play her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, you're also busy as a member of the planning committee, so juggling both roles won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'm going to leave it up to you. Keep in mind that we have a few other suitable candidates.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, juggling both duties isn't going to be easy. Both are big responsibilities...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll do it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. You all have faith in me, and I want to answer that trust.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And it's true, I did feel some kinship with her, with the way my friends gave me the push I needed to start really going after my dream...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I promise to do my absolute best, with all of you beside me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, Nene will be playing our protagonist.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now, let's decide the other roles as well.
Starting with the first musician our heroine meets...
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Considering that this is the first time on stage for many of you, you're projecting your voices incredibly well! I'd like for you all to bring the same energy next time!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Alright, we're just about out of time.
That concludes today's practice. Thank you all for coming.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm exhausted!
Wow, acting's so hard...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? I thought you did a great job of playing your character, An.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She is the musician who gets Lulu to feel passionate about music, after all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You two were also perfect, Airi, Ichika!
I loved how you played the musician who inspires courage in her, and the musician who shows her how fun music is!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Who would've guessed that we'd all be playing musicians? It's a big responsibility, but let's all do our best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As actors and friends, we're going to give you all the support we can, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate it!
